title: MyNote Notebooks Manifest
description: Root manifest stored at '{dataRoot}/notebooks.json'. Holds the full notebook → chapter → page/subpage hierarchy and metadata only — actual canvas content lives in separate 'page.json' files, see page-content.schema.json. Mirrors application/src/renderer/src/types/index.ts (Notebook, Section, PageMeta) and the mutations in application/src/renderer/src/store/notebookStore.ts.

notebookId.description: Id of the owning notebook. Must match an entry in the top-level array.

collapsed.description: Sidebar collapse state of this chapter's page tree. Absent is equivalent to false.

pages.description: Top-level pages of this chapter (not including nested subpages, which live under each page's 'children').

sectionId.description: Id of the chapter this page (or subpage) belongs to — the same for every node in a subpage chain.

collapsed.description: Sidebar collapse state of this page's subpage tree. Absent is equivalent to false.

children.description: Nested subpages, recursively of the same shape. Empty array if there are none (never omitted/null).
